text:
mira: Heads-up — our P4d Savings Plan expires in 21 days. utilization for p4d across prod clusters is only ~68% last quarter. we need to decide whether to renew full coverage, do a partial renewal, or pivot some workloads to spot + reserve mix. :thinking_face:
oliver: for context — what's our tolerance for spot for low-priority batch? any hard SLOs that block moving 10–20% to spot?
raj: Prod inference pods have 99.9% p95 latency SLO. batch training and evals can run on spot, obviously. live-serving pools not great for spot. we could target spot for training, eval, and nightly compaction jobs (~30% of current p4d consumption).
sasha: I ran a quick coverage query this morning, numbers from cost-ops: total p4d hours = 48,500; covered by savings/reservations = 33,080 (68.2%); unused reserved capacity = 2,100 hours (5.3% of reserved) — looks like some slots are idle.
infra-bot: <infra-bot> reservation-usage-report generated for account: redwood-main, region: us-west-2, period: 2025-10-01..2025-12-31. report: https://internal-reports/redwood/reservation-usage/1935554321
harper: Can we rightsize the reserved count? If we reduce commit by 15% and shift that to spot, numbers say we save X on upfront vs e.g. commit penalty. Finance has a model. @finance-bot can you run a quick delta?
finance-bot: <finance-bot> quick delta: 15% reduction on 3yr convertible savings -> estimated cashflow change: +$72k annual OPEX, -$420k in CAPEX/commitment. Effective per-hour cost increases ~8% for covered hours but saves on unused capacity. (rough sketch)
mira: Thanks. Two follow-ups: 1) a plan to drain low-priority pods onto spot and reclaim reserved slots; 2) a reconciliation of idle reserved capacity (who owns those nodes).
oliver: I'll take obj #1. plan: identify batch job labels (k8s label: workload=training or workload=eval), add taints/tolerations and a nodepool with spot p4d for those. rollout script draft:
```
# move batch deployments to spot nodepool
kubectl cordon nodepool-p4d-reserved-1
kubectl drain nodepool-p4d-reserved-1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
apply k8s label selector: workload in (training,eval) -> nodeSelector: spot-p4d
```
raj: For #2, infra tagging is messy. I'll run a billing export join with our cluster tags and owners. quick SQL to find owners with idle capacity:
```
SELECT owner, SUM(reserved_hours - used_hours) as idle_hours
FROM reservation_usage
WHERE region='us-west-2' AND instance_type LIKE 'p4d%'
GROUP BY owner
ORDER BY idle_hours DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
sasha: Also found two reservations purchased under a test account (testops) accidentally. that explains ~800 unused hours. we should move those workloads back to prod or terminate the reservation.
mira: Good catch. action items: 1) @oliver to implement spot nodepools and migration plan (ETA 3 working days); 2) @raj to produce owner reconciliation and list of orphaned reservations (ETA 48 hours); 3) @sasha to flag test account reservations and coordinate with testops (ETA today); 4) @finance-bot to model 3 scenarios: full renew, 15% reduction + spot mix, aggressive 30% reduction + 6mo convertible (ETA EOD tomorrow). I'll schedule a decision sync after those come in. :thumbsup:
harper: +1. Also can we add automatic alerts when reservation utilization drops below 75% for a 30-day window? saves us looking manually.
infra-bot: <infra-bot> created alert policy: reservation_utilization < 0.75 for 30d -> notify #eng-infra and paging contact: infra-oncall. policy id: rsv-alert-2025-09
mira: Perfect. anyone object to moving forward with pilot (15% shift) once Raj/Sasha/Finance confirm numbers?
raj: no objections. will prioritize owner list.
oliver: will start drafting k8s manifests and CI gating to ensure we don't move latency-critical pods.
sasha: ping me when the manifests exist, I'll run a dry run in staging and verify eviction tolerances. :white_check_mark:
mira: cool — thanks team. I'll create a short doc summarizing the decision options and link the reports.
harper: can you add rough forecast table in the doc: columns = scenario, estimated annual $ delta, estimated impact on p95 latency, risk level. helps execs.
mira: will do. closing notes: timeline is tight — decision by next week. :alarm_clock:
